WeRide's Q3 Revenue Surges 88% to a Record High as Overseas Revenue Jumps 172% and Robotaxi Revenue Tops RMB 100 Million

WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD, HKEX: 0800), a global leader in autonomous driving technology, today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 20, 2026.

In the third quarter of 2026, WeRide recorded total revenue of US$48.0 million, up 88% year over year and 39% quarter over quarter, marking a record high for quarterly revenue and significantly exceeding market expectations. Gross margin reached 43%, while revenue from higher-margin overseas operations was US$21.9 million. This accounted for nearly half of total revenue, emerging as the company's strongest growth driver during the quarter.

WeRide accelerated the expansion of its asset-light overseas Robotaxi business, with global Robotaxi revenue exceeding RMB 100 million for the first time, up 204% year over year, with more than 90% of Robotaxi revenue generated overseas. WeRide's autonomous vehicles have been deployed in 13 countries and over 60 cities, with its global L4 fleet comprising approximately 4,100 vehicles, including more than 2,300 Robotaxis.

In Europe, WeRide partnered with Uber and AVOMO to secure Spain's first national operating permit for L4 autonomous passenger vehicles, laying the groundwork for commercial Robotaxi services in Madrid. In the Middle East, WeRide's Robotaxi services have achieved major coverage of the core urban areas in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. In China, WeRide's self-operated Robotaxi fleet in Guangzhou achieved positive unit economics for the first time, marking a key step towards sustainable operations at the city level.

Technology built on the same foundation as WeRide's L4 autonomous driving capabilities is also gaining traction in the mass-production passenger vehicle market. By the end of the third quarter, cumulative deliveries of WeRide's proprietary WRD 3.0 one-stage end-to-end ADAS solution exceeded 100,000 units. During the quarter, WRD 3.0 secured 10 new mass-production design wins and entered into mass-production partnerships with multiple automakers.

Autonomous driving serves as WeRide's starting point for validating Physical AI at scale. Building on the technological capabilities developed through its autonomous driving operations, WeRide is extending its expertise to support the development of Physical AI foundation models, providing high-quality datasets, training environments and verification services to customers across the foundation model, embodied AI and robotics sectors. This growing demand for high-quality physical-world data drove nearly 100% year-over-year growth in the Company's AI infrastructure business revenue in Q3, with several billion RMB in outstanding orders.
